confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and city context; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most stable. July lodging is less certain because Gion Matsuri and summer demand push room rates up. USD values assume roughly 150 yen per US dollar, so a materially different yen rate would shift every anchor. Cocktail and wine anchors are cross-checked against the beer anchor, at roughly twice and one and a half times its price.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Japanese urban price levels, close to Osaka for food and drink, with a tourism premium on central Kyoto lodging in July.
